title: Listen
line: Understand strategy, audience, brand codes and commercial objectives.

title: Distil
line: Find the emotional truth inside the brief.

title: Develop
line: Turn that truth into a compelling creative territory.

title: Build
line: Create the story, visual world and production system.

title: Produce
line: Bring the idea to life using the strongest production method available.

title: Scale
line: Extend the central idea intelligently across channels, markets and formats.
